Package fr.cytech.safeexit.model.sensor

Class SeatSensor

java.lang.Object
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.observer.AbstractObservable
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.sensor.SeatSensor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Observable, Serializable
public class SeatSensor extends AbstractObservable
Occupancy sensor attached to a single seat.

It holds the real-time SeatStatus of its seat and, when occupied, a reference to the spectator sitting there. Any status change notifies the observers (the row sensor, the views) through a SEAT_STATE_CHANGED event, so occupancy is tracked live, exactly like a physical sensor would.

1.0
